provenance.provenance_authority: Triptych editorial projection verified by page-image collation against the 1962 target edition
provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: antecedent witness is the Mame, Tours 1922 (editio quarta iuxta typicam Vaticanam); 100% of the 1962 body's tokens align in order after canon folding; the Mame prints j where the 1962 prints i (Iesum/Jesum, eius/ejus) and its recogniser renders the ae ligature as 'z' or 'e'; both are orthographic; pointing: the antecedent's reading is recorded verbatim above so its commas and colons can be compared, but its punctuation is NOT safely collatable - the recogniser turns commas into full stops, semicolons and question marks - so no punctuation difference here should be read as a difference between the printings; the 1962 prints the conclusion as 'Per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.'; conclusion length was excluded from the alignment and is recorded here as printed, per the settled rule. Corroboration: none reached the 0.45 threshold.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Beatorum Martyrum tuorum, Domine, Chrysanthi et Dariae, quaesumus, adsit
nobis oratio: ut, quos veneramur obsequio, eorum pium jugiter experiamur
auxilium. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit
et regnat in unitate.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Populi tui, quaesumus, Domine, tibi grata sit hostia, quae in nataliciis
sanctorum Martyrum tuorum Chrysanthi et Dariae solemniter immolatur. Per
Dominum.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Mysticis, Domine, repleti sumus votis et gaudiis: praesta, quaesumus; ut,
intercessionibus sanctorum Martyrum tuorum Chrysanthi et Dariae, quae
temporaliter agimus, spiritualiter consequamur. Per Dominum.
